purpose: owner 2026-10-25: the outputs get the rigour of the inputs; categorical decisions are categorical heads, continuous risk parameters are bounded continuous heads, the strategy is an explicit optimisable layer, and no choice is made on the block that decides; v1.1 (2026-10-25): early close is indispensable (owner): a strategy that never closes voluntarily on the calibration block is DEGENERATE_NO_EARLY_CLOSE and not selectable

actions.HOLD: flat: no entry (NOP); positioned: keep the position
actions.OPEN_LONG: flat: buy at the next open with the opener's TP/SL
actions.OPEN_SHORT: flat: sell at the next open with the opener's TP/SL
actions.CLOSE: positioned: close at the next open

action_space.reverse: an open of the opposite side while positioned = close-and-reverse (env CLOSE_AND_OPEN), only when strategy.allow_reverse
action_space.every_order: broker-side SL and TP on every order (env), 1 entry/day and 1:50 (replay contract)
action_space.encoding_rule: every action is a class of a softmax_ce head; continuous heads (TP/SL) only parameterise an order and enter the decision through the expected gain

decision.class_weights: 1/sqrt(train frequency), normalised to mean 1 over the training rows (as E1-T)

tp_sigma.mask: rows whose label is an OPEN of this side
tp_sigma.network: lo + (hi - lo) * sigmoid(z) inside the network
tp_sigma.target: the demonstrator's TP: remaining gain to its next pivot (sigma), clipped to the bounds

sl_sigma.mask: rows whose label is an OPEN of this side
sl_sigma.network: lo + (hi - lo) * sigmoid(z) inside the network
sl_sigma.target: the demonstrator's SL: 2 sigma for the ZigZag demonstrators, the oracle's SL on DAgger rows

open_l.labels: the arm's own opener labels (--labels / --closer-rule / --extra-experts), unchanged

tp_sigma.target: the demonstrator's TP: remaining gain to its next pivot (sigma), clipped to the bounds

decision.class_weights: 1/sqrt(train frequency), normalised to mean 1 over the training rows (as E1-T)
decision.sample_weights: NopLabels weight (1; the multires weight for graded / negative / conflict)

labels.source: multires ladder scored against the optimum (multires.MultiResLabels, default Thresholds)
labels.consistency: arm opens on the row -> NOP = 0 (so NOP = 1 implies open_l = open_s = 0); arm does not open and some resolution trades well -> NOP = 0; arm does not open and the ladder says no / graded / negative / conflict -> NOP = 1 with its weight
labels.rows: flat rows of round-0 demonstrations and of every DAgger round's visits

decision.class_weights: 1/sqrt(train frequency), normalised to mean 1 over the training rows (as E1-T)

close_l.labels: the arm's exit rule (SL before TP or negative at the forced flat; signal modes add their closer rule)

decision.class_weights: 1/sqrt(train frequency), normalised to mean 1 over the training rows (as E1-T)

close_s.labels: the arm's exit rule (SL before TP or negative at the forced flat; signal modes add their closer rule)

calibration.map: p = sigmoid(a * z + b), z = logit margin (l1 - l0)
calibration.why: the 1/sqrt(freq) class weights shift the logit prior; a temperature alone (a = 1/T, b = 0) cannot remove that shift, the bias b does

reported.INNER_A: before and after calibration (the block it is fitted on)

calibration.ensemble: mean of the seeds' calibrated probabilities, then ONE Platt map refitted on the ensemble on INNER_A (round-0 label rows)

strategy.name: parametric_v1
strategy.rule: flat: veto when the NOP veto is kept and pNOP > nop_veto; else open the side with the larger expected gain among sides with p > open_threshold and gain > gain_margin; positioned: exit when p_close > close_threshold, then close-and-reverse when allow_reverse and the open rule names the other side, else CLOSE
strategy.gain: p * TP - (1 - p) * SL - cost; cost = COST_SIGMA (0.1, declared allowance for what the simulator does not price) + the replay contract's round-trip cost (RealisticProfile.round_trip_price: mean spread + 2 market slippages + 2 commissions, price units) / causal sigma at the fill bar; all terms sigma multiples
strategy.nop_veto_test: two optimisations, without and with the veto; the veto stays only if it strictly improves the chosen calibration-block lower confidence bound (pre-registered); otherwise nop is reported and disabled

optimizer.method: NSGA-II (DEAP): SBX eta 15 p 0.9, polynomial mutation eta 20 indpb 0.2, tournament DCD
optimizer.seed: the run seed (ensemble: the smallest member seed)
optimizer.constraint: Deb constraint domination: feasible (>= 2.0 trades/week and the env rules, at least one trade, defined Sharpe) beats infeasible; between infeasible points the smaller violation (2.0 - orders/week, + 1 per other broken rule) wins; between feasible points Pareto on (Sharpe, DD)
optimizer.archive: every evaluated point of every generation of every search (final and visitation, per seed and on the ensemble) with genes, every component, every fitness, Sharpe, SE, return, DD, trades, orders/week, weeks below 2, feasibility, violation and reasons

strategy.choice: the arm's fitness variant picks the frozen point among the valid non-dominated (Sharpe, DD) points; ties -> lower max DD
strategy.out_of_sample_activity: trades/week on INNER_B reported; below 2 there = INVALID by the owner's rule

variants.sharpe_lcb: F0: annualized daily Sharpe - 1 Lo (2002) SE
variants.sharpe_plus_return: F1 (owner): c_s * Sharpe + c_r * R, R = net profit / initial balance annualized to the block length (x 365 / calendar days); scaled
variants.sharpe_plus_return_plus_activity: F2 (owner): c_s * Sharpe + c_r * R + c_o * orders/day (orders/week / 5, in [0, 1] under the 1 entry/day cap; no weekly upper cap); scaled
variants.trade_tstat: F3, REUSED: heuristic-strategy app/walk_forward_optimizer.py::_sharpe_fitness (per-trade mean / std ddof 0 x sqrt(N), rejected below 15 trades) on per-trade returns in sigma net of every cost
variants.return_minus_dd: F5, REUSED (reimplemented with citation): agent-multi agent_plugins/sac_agent.py::fitness = total_return - lambda * maxDD/100, lambda = ga_fitness_dd_lambda = 1.0; return annualized to the block length
variants.balanced: F6: c_s * Sharpe + c_r * R + c_o * orders/day - c_d * DD%; scaled

fitness.invalid: a zero-trade point records trades = 0 and Sharpe = NaN with its reason and is kept; undefined components are NaN (never 0, never -inf); only valid points with a finite value are selectable
fitness.nop_veto_per_variant: the veto stays for a variant only if it strictly improves that variant's chosen point's calibration-block lower confidence bound
fitness.recorded: every front point carries its components (sharpe, se_lo, lcb, r_ann, opd, trade_t, calmar, dd, opw, trades) and every variant's fitness

scaling.rule: pre-registered: c_k = 1 / s_k, s_k = median |term_k| over the VALID points of the calibration-block front of this fold and arm (the union of the two NSGA-II searches, without and with the NOP veto); never computed on the decision block
scaling.fallback_note: owner-declared: Sharpe 1.0, annualized return 0.2, orders/day 0.6, Calmar 5.0, return - DD 0.1; DD% 5.0 is Satoshi's (no owner value), declared for audit
scaling.recorded: s_k, c_k, median, fallback flag per term in E3M.json and in the report

fitness.report: per (arm, fold, fitness): the chosen valid point and the archive view (best unconstrained Sharpe, best unconstrained by the fitness with its INNER_B metrics marked NOT SELECTABLE, best valid point, share of valid points)

strategy.activity_rule: owner 2026-10-25 (correction): exactly 2.0 trades/week as a period average, a SELECTION criterion; no calibration margin; no weekly upper cap; weeks below 2 reported as a diagnostic only
strategy.continuous_use: TP/SL enter only the expected gain p * TP - (1 - p) * SL - cost (a decision-theoretic value of the categorical probability); no class is read off an interval of a continuous output
strategy.early_close_rule: owner 2026-10-25 (pre-registered before any audit number was read): early close is indispensable; with strategy.require_early_close a point that never closes voluntarily on the calibration block (agent closes = 0) is DEGENERATE_NO_EARLY_CLOSE and not selectable; it stays in the archive

dagger_visitation: round 0 = the demonstrator's own trajectory + exploration positions (unchanged); rounds 1..3 visit TRAIN and INNER_A with the strategy frozen on INNER_A after the previous round (visitation budget)

decision_block_uses: scored once after the freeze; decides between arms through the seed ensemble

constraints.sample_weights_flag: not supported in v1 (the nop specialist carries its own weights)

derived_from.change: strategy.require_early_close = true (selection rule only; archive unchanged)
